description: We are students at a school in Tashkent. We want to learn more about space, even though we don't know how to program
summary: With our project, we wanted to help children who are passionate about space to explore it more easily. "Heroes of space discoveries" is a fascinating project in which each device tells about itself, thereby attracting a young audience. Our project tells about NASA equipment, about their discoveries that have made a great contribution to the history of space exploration.
details:
"Heroes of space discoveries" is an interactive presentation that is intended for an audience of 10-11 year old children. With this project, we want to spread space exploration among teenagers and children.

In our project, people can study stories of interest with the help of independent choice by clicking on planets and devices.

We made our project in the form of an interactive children's presentation, which helps to learn and memorise information more easily.

To create our project, we used NASA data as well as Gemini and ChatGPT. We used Gemini and ChatGPT to compress information and translate it into a more childish and understandable language.

There are 2 people in our team, which complicated our work and added restrictions. There was also a time limit that reduced our ability to do a lot of work, but we did the job to the maximum use of our skills and capabilities.
